clock: received_ts_ns; exchange timestamps only for freshness; no calibrated execution latency
size_semantics: Raw L5 native quantity only; not certified as BTC, USDT or historical contract units
rules: Rules fixed before this benchmark; all history diagnostic_reuse, no untouched holdout claimed
Each UTC quarter-hour generates both sides and every size/latency; no outcome-based selection
Reference quote is the last causally received fresh quote, arrival uses first accepted book at/after due time; zero latency also waits for an observed new book
Reset at raw session change or gap above five seconds between accepted books; never cross segments
Reference, arrival and completed one-second features must satisfy freshness and decision cutoff
Features rebuilt on demand from raw accepted events, not old second_buckets; sampled ten-second windows are not a full derived archive
Book consumption is hypothetical taker VWAP across at most five displayed levels, no partial fill or extrapolation beyond depth
Signed latency movement, instantaneous spread/depth and assumed fees/slippage reported separately
Stress doubles displayed-liquidity cost and fee/slippage assumptions, retains measured latency movement; no calibrated stressed market-impact claim
Preserve every unavailable intent in denominators, never substitute future quotes outside arrival deadline
No holding-period return, markout, funding PnL, signal, queue simulation or promotion calculated
No BTC/USDT conversion or exchange-admissibility validation; unknown minima do not block this native-unit research diagnostic
